# volcano_sandbox (Resource)

A standing, reusable sandbox environment. Distinct from the ephemeral exec/session endpoints the API also exposes, which this provider does not manage (they're runtime actions, not infrastructure).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_sandbox" "dev" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  name       = "dev"
  preset     = "small"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `preset` (String) See the volcano_sandbox_presets data source for valid values. Forces replacement if changed.
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `memory_mb` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_sandbox.dev <project-id>,<sandbox-id>
```
